data.title: 夜刀神十香 · 紫晶穹顶下的花嫁
data.description: 【精灵天宫结界·黄昏】十香穿上为她准备的纯白婚纱，紫黑长发与大蝴蝶结在浮空花瓣间轻轻飘动；她把捧花举到鼻尖闻了闻，发现自己真的要走向誓约时，紫瞳里满是坦率而灿烂的期待。
data.location: crystal spirit cathedral above the city
data.action: 浮空花瓣间捧花闻香后迈向誓约，紫瞳里满是坦率期待
data.lighting: violet sunset filtered through crystal panels
data.mood: 纯真而热烈的誓约期待
data.promptProse: Tohka Yatogami lifts her bouquet to smell the flowers beneath the crystal dome, then takes a delighted step toward the viewer. Her luminous white bridal gown carries crystal embroidery and a large violet ribbon under a sheer veil. Floating petals circle the hem in the vertical medium-full view. Violet sunset filtered through the dome colors her expectant eyes and gown edges, while ceremonial lights glint along the crystal panels overhead.
